description: FOREIGN KEY / PRIMARY KEY / UNIQUE constraint metadata (parsed, not enforced) through SHOW IMPORTED/PRIMARY/UNIQUE KEYS and DESCRIBE TABLE, with cell reads via RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()): auto-named SYS_CONSTRAINT_ keys, multi-column keys one row per column, referential actions other than NO ACTION silently dropping the whole constraint (live-verified), RELY/NORELY metadata, and non-enforcement of FK/cascade semantics on DML. Converted 1:1 from constraints/ForeignKeyConstraintsTest (now retired).
